use: Numbers that people need to fill in or mention somewhere else.
avoid: Long text or code: use a code block.
behaviour: Copies with the clipboard. If that fails, the text is selected.
a11y: After copying there is a status message for screen readers.
The field is read-only but can get focus, and selects its text on focus.
name: Copy input
summary: Value to copy, like a customer number, case number or IBAN. After copying it shows "Copied" for 2 seconds.
